title: Task compatibility module shadows the task package it tries to re-export
reasoning: The file is named hub/tasks.py but imports from dotted modules under hub.tasks. In Python, a module file named hub/tasks.py is not a package and cannot contain submodules such as hub.tasks.email_tasks, hub.tasks.armenian_text_tasks, or hub.tasks.bible_api_tasks. Any code importing hub.tasks or one of the task submodules can resolve to this file and fail with a package/module collision, breaking Celery task discovery and the tests that import those submodules.
reproduction: Run a Python import for one of the tested task modules, for example `python -c "import hub.tasks.armenian_text_tasks"`; with hub/tasks.py present as the resolved hub.tasks module, the dotted import cannot succeed because hub.tasks has no package path.
recommendation: Remove the module/package collision. Move these backward-compatible re-exports into hub/tasks/__init__.py, or rename this shim so hub.tasks remains a real package. Keep the same __all__ exports from the package initializer if legacy `from hub.tasks import send_fast_reminder_task` imports must continue to work.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests import task submodules, but they do not include an explicit regression around the compatibility shim itself or verify that legacy `hub.tasks` imports and package submodule imports both work in the same interpreter.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an import smoke test that imports `hub.tasks`, `hub.tasks.email_tasks`, `hub.tasks.armenian_text_tasks`, and `hub.tasks.bible_api_tasks` in one process, then asserts the legacy exported task names are available from `hub.tasks`.
minimumFixScope: Replace hub/tasks.py with a real hub/tasks package initializer containing the re-exports, and ensure no file remains at hub/tasks.py.

history.reasoning: The original collision is no longer present in the current worktree: `hub/tasks.py` is deleted (`test -e hub/tasks.py` returned 1, and `git diff` shows it as a deleted file), while `hub/tasks/__init__.py` now exists and contains the compatibility re-exports from real package submodules. The cited test imports still exist at `hub/tests/test_armenian_text.py:13` and `hub/tests/test_bible_api.py:30-33`, and a new smoke test `hub/tests/test_task_imports.py` explicitly imports `hub.tasks` plus `hub.tasks.email_tasks`, `hub.tasks.armenian_text_tasks`, and `hub.tasks.bible_api_tasks` in one process and checks legacy exports.
